# Noxstone - Lawn & Landscape

Noxstone is a lawn and landscape maintenance company serving Pottawatomie County, Oklahoma, including Shawnee, Tecumseh, McLoud, Bethel Acres, Dale, and nearby communities.

## Core Services

- Lawn Maintenance: mowing, edging, string trimming, blow-off, mowing pattern variation, and weekly or bi-weekly route-based service.
- Landscape Maintenance: shrub trimming, bed weeding, weed-control treatment, mulch refresh, bed edging, light pruning, and seasonal bed resets.
- Property Cleanup: leaf cleanup, seasonal cleanups, storm debris pickup, overgrowth cleanup, bed clean-out, and hard-surface blow-down.
